decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD costs little to keep in a warehouse-backed catalog, and this specialist label typically keeps such titles available until stock runs out, so there is little reason to delist it.

The illustrated series is a multi-model line with substantial editorial and production investment and visible label branding, so dropping it would write off sunk costs and contradict the firm's curated-edition positioning.
Reissuing overlooked music is the firm's core competence, so the jazz vinyl reissue fits its announced direction, and slow sales of collector vinyl can be attributed to temporary market conditions.
A multi-disc box set embodies heavy upfront investment in licensing, mastering and packaging and is a flagship of the label's carefully produced editions, so management will persist with it.

The compilation CD involved little investment and was only mentioned rather than showcased, so it is the most expendable product, but carrying cost in a large catalog is minimal, so it likely stays listed until sold through.
